questions.prompt: How does jealousy differ conceptually from envy?
questions.answer: Jealousy often concerns a relationship threat; envy concerns wanting another's advantage.

questions.prompt: What is the priority in immediate danger?

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Distinguishes anger, fear and jealousy, separates appraisal from evidence and chooses safe, non-coercive actions.
scoring.transfer: Analyse a novel fictional case in which anger and fear coexist. Distinguish known facts from inferred intent, compare two responses and identify a safety exception. Explain why the label alone cannot justify an action.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
